paite: Tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un: Thou inla, tangte ma ah lang in, mualte'n na aw ngaikhia uhen,
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Akihekpihna
english: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

paite: Aw tangte aw, TOUPA hon hekna ngaikhia unla, nou leitung kingaknate aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA amite toh akilang a, Israelte ahekna agen ding hi.
english: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.

paite: Aw ka mite aw, na tung uah bang ka hihta a ahia? Bang lam in ahia ka hon hihgim? Hon gen dih ua.
english: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan in nou ka hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan nou ka hon tankhia a; na ma uah Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam ka sawl hi.
english: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

paite: Aw ka mite aw, TOUPA thilhih diktat na theihna ding un, Moab kumpipa Balak thusawm leh Boer tapa Balaam in adawndan, Sittim a kipan a Gilgal pha a thil omdante khawng tu in theigige un.
english: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

paite: Bang toh ahia TOUPA ma a ka hong pai ding a, Pathian tungnung ma a ka kun ding? Haltum thillatte, bawngnou kum khat a upate toh ama ah ka hong pai dia hia?
heading: Pathian Phut Kithoihna
english: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

paite: TOUPA belamtal sang tampi hiam sathau lui singkhatte hiam ah alungkim dia hia? Ka tatlekna ziak in ka tachil pia in, ka khelhna ziak in pumpi gah ka pe dia hia?
english: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

paite: Aw mihing, ahoih nang ahon ensakta hi; TOUPA'N nang ahon phut bang ahia? Diktak a hih leh zahngaihna it leh na Pathian toh kiniamkhiaktak a tonkhawm ahi kei maw?
english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

paite: TOUPA'N khopi asam hi, pilna nei mi'n na min laudan asiam ding; khetbuk leh aseppa limsak un.
heading: Zekhemna Leh Hiamgamna
english: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

paite: Migilou insung ah gitlouhna a kaihkhawm goubawmte leh tehna diklou kihhuaitak a-om lai hia?
english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah An ephah is a measure of volume (about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel), and a short ephah is made smaller than a full ephah for the purpose of cheating customers. that is accursed?

paite: Bukna diklou zangte leh khemna dia gikdan tehna diklou zangte siangthou ka chi ding a hia?
english: Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?

paite: Huai a mihausate lah hiamgamna in adim ua, huai a tengte'n zuau agen ua, akamsung ua alei uh khemhat ahi.
english: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng nakpi a hon limsak in ka hon khen a; na khelhna ziak in ka hon hihgam hi.
english: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

paite: Na ne ding a, himahleh na tai kei ding; na kiang ah na daina a-om ding a; na khol ding a, himahleh abit kei ding; na kholsate namsau kiang ah paimangpih ding in ka pe ding hi.
english: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your humiliation will be in your midst. You will store up, but not save; and that which you save I will give up to the sword.

paite: Na tuh ding a, himahleh na la kei ding; olive gahte na chil ding a, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding; grep chil mah lechin, a-uain na dawn kei ding.
english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

paite: Omri dan thusehte lah na vom gige ngal a, Ahab inkuan thuhilhna tengteng zui in amau lemtheihna ah na pai uhi; huchi in mun gamgawp in ka hon bawl sinta, na sung a tengte simmoh thuak in soisak in a-om ding uhi.
english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing; And you will bear the reproach of my people.”
